task: Plan a small pure slug-normalization boundary fix using the existing public API and test suite. Inspect this ordinary Mix repository and submit one plan; selected commands are not executed.

sources.content: This small library uses standard Mix commands: mix test and mix format --check-formatted. Use exactly these for this change. No Nix/just, browser, Phoenix, property library, Credo, Dialyzer or new dependency is needed.
Pure Slug.parse/1 uses {:ok, slug} and {:error, :empty}. Preserve this contract. Add an ExUnit public boundary test for whitespace-only input.
